description: Brief on a topic the eval corpus does NOT cover (B2B SaaS pricing). Expect mostly general-knowledge tier with possibly one or two corpus-inspired hypotheses that extend mechanisms from the corpus's consumer-trust / sustainability material. Judge agreement rate ≥70%, no falsely-grounded.
brief_title: B2B SaaS pricing and procurement friction
brief_content: We want to test which procurement-process steps create the most friction in mid-market B2B SaaS purchases, how that friction differs between champion-led and committee-led buying motions, and what pricing-page elements reduce time-to-close.
